annotation.title_clean: Presidente Luis Abinader encabeza lanzamiento de Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: President Luis Abinader leads launch of National Artificial Intelligence Strategy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de la Presidencia de la República Dominicana
annotation.venue: Ministerio de la Presidencia (presidencia.gob.do) – Notas de Prensa
annotation.summary_en: Dominican government press release announcing the launch of the National AI Strategy (ENIA), part of the National Innovation Policy 2030. It describes four pillars: smart government, talent and innovation hub, data hub, and regional scale. It mentions a proposed international treaty banning AI as a weapon of war. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: ENIA launched as priority project of Política Nacional de Innovación 2030
Four pillars: Gobierno Inteligente, HUB de Talento #YoSoyFuturoRD, HUB de Datos, Escala Regional
Pillar 1 calls for policies and regulatory frameworks for ethical, responsible AI use
Government states commitment to an international treaty prohibiting AI as a weapon of war
MoU with Genia Latinoamérica for Latam 4.0 coalition; BCIE and CAF funding support
